title:
Code analysis metric that identifies invocations of the following single DB write operations in a loop:

  - `create` instead of `createBatch`
  - `upsert` instead of `upsertBatch`
  - `merge` instead of `mergeBatch`
  - `remove` instead of `removeBatch`

This is known to cause PSR issues in production environments with large amounts of data.
name: BaseCodeAnalysis.Metric.PsrLoopSingleDbWrite
